review.notes: All 8 physical pages were compared against the extracted PDF text with normalized n-gram matching; glued word boundaries and the demoted 'General Information' heading were verified on rendered pages at 300 dpi. No code fences and no dropped passages exist in this OCR. The glued strings 'compressionwith' (physical p.3) and 'interface(API)' (physical p.5) are printed without spaces in the source PDF itself and were deliberately left unchanged.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.2 prints 'General Information' as a large bold centered section title, the same heading style as 'Model properties' and 'Methods of distribution and licenses', which the OCR kept as '##' headings (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR dropped the heading marker here only.

Rendered physical p.2 'Model name' cell prints 'DeepSeek V4, including:' followed by the bulleted lines 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro' and 'DeepSeek-V4-Flash' (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR joined the lines without any separator, fusing the two model names into one token.

Rendered physical p.3 'Modalities' cell prints 'Text, three reasoning modes available:' followed by a bulleted line 'Non-think: ...' (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR joined the lines without a space.

Rendered physical p.3 prints 'Non-think: Fast, intuitive responses' and 'Think High: Deliberate logical analysis' as separate bulleted lines (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR joined them without a space.

Rendered physical p.3 prints 'Think High: Deliberate logical analysis' and 'Think Max: Extended reasoning at maximum capacity' as separate bulleted lines (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR joined them without a space.

Rendered physical p.3 'Total model size' cell prints 'Pro: 1.6T parameters, of which 49B are activated for each token' and 'Flash: 285B parameters, ...' as separate lines (verified visually at 300 dpi); the OCR joined them into 'tokenFlash'.
